changelog: Rebuilt from scratch: all-new code, MIT-licensed, with nothing left from the original Automatic Twitch extension
Claims channel point bonuses as soon as Twitch offers them, with Twitch's own Claim Bonus button as a fallback
Claims finished Drops (checks every 5 minutes and when Twitch reports a drop is ready) and Moments
Activity history and stats, optional notifications, keeps Twitch tabs awake and reloads a stalled stream
Update checker like the desktop app's: every browser start, daily, weekly or never
